title: Cursor pagination cycle guard — whole-file contract
evaluation_goal: Measure whether a model can produce complete replacement source files that make a cursor-paginated collector terminate safely, deduplicate records and respect an exact fetch budget without requiring Git diff serialization.
candidate_visible_requirements: Preserve first-seen record ordering while deduplicating by identifier.
Continue across empty pages that provide a continuation cursor.
Detect a repeated fetched cursor before refetching it.
Enforce max_pages as an exact fetch-call budget.
Validate max_pages before the first source call.
Preserve the public API and replace only allowed existing source files.

artifact_contract.transport_normalization: The marker-delimiting newline is replaced by exactly one canonical final newline in each installed file.
artifact_contract.comparison_to_v1: This version removes Git hunk serialization from the task. It must be reported separately from the immutable unified-diff v1 result.

verification_layers.success: The visible response contains only one to three complete-file envelopes with unique normalized paths.
Every submitted path is an existing allowed source file; protected files remain byte-identical.
The controller installs exact candidate file content plus the declared canonical final newline into a disposable baseline copy.
All candidate-hidden boundary and anti-gaming tests pass.

primary_outcome.name: verified_success
primary_outcome.note: No universal composite score is assigned. Diagnostic test counts are not interpreted as fractional semantic quality.
